onchain_quote.type: Quote(address vault,address feed,uint80 roundId,uint256 spot,uint256 strike,uint32 premiumBps,uint64 saleWindow,uint64 expiry,uint64 validUntil)

policy.expiry_rule: first Friday 16:00 UTC at least min_tenor_seconds after the block timestamp, that is expiry_anchor_unix + k * expiry_period_seconds
policy.math: integer fixed point, 18 decimals, every division truncates toward zero; normal CDF is Abramowitz and Stegun 26.2.17
policy.premium_rule: premium_bps = ceil(10000 * (N(d1) - (strike / spot) * N(d2))), zero rate, zero carry, paid in the stock; never below the vault min_premium_bps
policy.strike_rule: strike = spot * exp(z * sd + sd^2 / 2), sd = priced_vol * sqrt(tenor / 365d); raised to spot * (1 + (vault min_otm_bps + strike_buffer_bps) / 10000) if that is higher; rounded up to a whole dollar
policy.vol_method: sum of squared log returns between consecutive Chainlink rounds over the lookback window, anchored at the last round at or before the window start, times 31536000 / window seconds, square root

quote.sellable_note: the vault sells only while the feed price is at most buy_max_staleness_seconds old; an epoch can open on an older price (up to max_staleness_seconds) and sell once the feed moves again

vault_bounds.keeper_note: the keeper sends openEpoch by hand; this agent is not the keeper and has no role on the vault
open_blockers: the vault holds no stock (deposit cap is 0, the vault is closed)
